input.quote: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled)
input.rationale: Section 6.1 imposes a field-of-use non-compete on the Company (our client). It fails the fallback on three material terms: the scope is elastic rather than limited to a named competing product ("products substantially similar to Deerskin Products" and "companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled"); the restriction runs for the whole term, which auto-renews annually, with no 12-month outside limit; and there is no carve-out for internal development or acquisitions (Section 6.2 carves out only a closeout-merchandise site). Because HDI's exclusive hosting bargain plausibly needs some protection, we take the fallback: narrow the restriction to the named Deerskin Products, cap it at 12 months, and add the internal-development and acquisition carve-outs. HDI's exclusive "Deerskin" brand right and the term limitation remain intact.

ops.oldText: during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet.
ops.newText: during the term of this Agreement, and in any event for no longer than 12 months, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet.

ops.text: The restriction in Section 6.1 shall not apply to the Company's internal development of web sites or e-commerce capabilities, or to any business or web site acquired by the Company.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot restrict the products we sell or the businesses we operate, so we have narrowed Section 6.1 to the named Deerskin Products, capped the restriction at 12 months, and carved out our internal development and acquired businesses; HDI's exclusive "Deerskin" right for the term is untouched.
proposal.summary: Narrow Section 6.1 to Deerskin Products, cap the restriction at 12 months, and add carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions.

mappings.element: Restriction limited to a named competing product.
